name: Command Code Usage
description: Composer chip opening a panel with Command Code account usage: five-hour and weekly spend windows, monthly credit balance, and the current billing period's totals straight from Command Code's alpha billing endpoints, via a loopback sidecar that keeps the API key out of the browser.
author: Brandon168

post_install.summary: Run the bundled sidecar (sidecar/sidecar.py) on 127.0.0.1:17800, then approve the sidecar proxy in Settings → Extensions → Diagnostics → Loopback sidecar card. The sidecar reads COMMANDCODE_API_KEY from its environment or ~/.hermes/.env. WebUI authentication must be enabled for the token-v1 proxy to work at all.

filesystem.note: The browser assets read no files. The sidecar reads one local file, read-only: the API key from ~/.hermes/.env (when it is not already in its environment). No application or state data is written; Python may create bounded bytecode caches inside the extension sidecar runtime directory.

permissions.network_external_note: The sidecar makes three outbound GETs to Command Code's alpha billing endpoints (api.commandcode.ai/alpha/billing/credits, .../billing/subscriptions, .../usage/summary) with the API key. The browser extension assets contact no external origin; they only call the same-origin sidecar proxy.

settings_schema.label: Refresh automatically while the panel is open
